channel.title: Ente Community Discord digest
channel.description: AI-generated daily recap of activity in the Ente Community Discord server

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 08, 2026 - 101 messages in 5 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw moderate activity across five channels, led by off-topic discussions and Ente Photos support. Conversations focused on privacy-conscious software, account longevity, and product feedback.

#off-topic

With 48 messages from six participants, the channel covered AI tool preferences, including Lumo and locally hosted models, plus recommendations for open-source PDF readers with annotation support. XODO and Episteme were suggested, while members also flagged and discussed a potentially fraudulent request.

#photos

Thirty-five messages from 11 participants discussed importing libraries from Google Photos, with clarification that Google Takeout is still required and interest in making migration easier. Members also troubleshot album creation, identifying that the button may require signing in, alongside self-hosting questions and a request to bring Photos-style OCR to Locker.

#locker

Fourteen messages from five participants focused on inactivity-related account deletion, proposals for lifetime or “Lite” Locker plans, and guarantees for Ente Auth. The discussion also covered Auth backups, 2FA feedback, and whether Photos’ OCR technology could be replicated; a feedback post was shared on Discord.

#ensu

Three messages discussed an answer-looping issue and a potential Ensu integration with private Obsidian vaults, earning support from another participant.

#memes

One message marked Friday.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 07, 2026 - 91 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
The server saw moderate activity across product support and community discussion, with the busiest conversations focused on privacy, Locker account policies, and Ente Photos features. Several threads also surfaced feedback and planned improvements from the team.

#off-topic

With 40 messages from 7 participants, discussion centered on using Instagram via the web or Beeper, reducing tracking, and balancing privacy with convenience. Members also compared Lumo, locally hosted AI, Gemini, Claude, and GPT.

#locker

Twenty-four messages from 5 participants covered finding active shared links, possible expiry dates and passwords, Legacy Kit support in the browser, and concerns about account inactivity and deletion. Staff said surfacing shared-link status and related improvements are planned, but provided no specific timelines; members also discussed Auth backups and 2FA feedback.

#photos

Fourteen messages from 7 participants covered retagging people on a new phone, duplicate shared-album items, and video stream generation. The team clarified that streams for shared videos currently generate only on the sharer’s device. Members also discussed the new OCR announcement, including extracting text from receipts, documents, cards, and screenshots; support requested logs at support@ente.com.

#ensu

Nine messages from 5 participants discussed local models in app packs, possible integrations with note-taking apps such as Slate, and Ensu’s answer-looping issue on Samsung Android. The team said it is evaluating which models work best for different devices and use cases.

#space

A Firefox desktop typing and cursor issue was reported, and Anand said it would be fixed in the next day’s update.

#memes

Two messages shared and reacted to an image, with a brief comment about installation priorities.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 06, 2026 - 126 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
Activity was led by #ensu, with discussions around on-device AI, notes, models, and future Ensu Packs. Other active threads covered photo imports and search, VPNs and privacy, and Ente’s legal obligations.

#ensu

With 58 messages from 24 participants, the channel focused on AI-assisted development, a possible notes-and-chat experience, on-device assistants, model downloads and performance, and ideas for new Packs including advanced math and Bible resources. The team also discussed evaluating which models work best on different devices and use cases.

#photos

Thirty messages from 14 participants covered Google Photos migration issues involving MP4s and motion photos, shared videos and album behavior, stream generation, duplicates, people retagging, and AI search result ordering. There was also a question about replacing Google Lens-style image identification.

#off-topic

Twenty-four messages from seven participants discussed privacy risks around public photos and AI scraping, along with a comparison of Windscribe and Mullvad. Participants highlighted split tunneling, location selection, browser-extension blocking, payment options, and router support.

#space

Eleven messages from six participants debated Proton, Ente, and legal data disclosure, focusing on what encrypted and account information services could provide under legal compulsion. A Firefox desktop issue involving typing “z” and cursor movement was also reported.

#introduce-yourself

Two brief greetings were shared.

#announcements

An update was announced for Ensu across all platforms, including the introduction of Ensu Packs on mobile.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 05, 2026 - 55 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
Activity was concentrated in #photos and #off-topic, with support discussions covering video playback, service availability, sharing controls, and public Space links. Smaller conversations covered Auth access, translation updates, and a few casual posts.

#photos

With 26 messages from 12 participants, members discussed slow playback for large shared videos, with video streaming suggested as a solution via Ente’s video-streaming documentation. The channel also reported and resolved a Photos login/API incident, referenced Ente’s status page, discussed quick-action ideas, album link permissions, file extensions, and an Android locking animation issue.

#off-topic

Twenty-two messages from seven participants focused on whether public Ente Space links could be crawled, including discussion of robots.txt, account-free sharing links, link validity, and a possible expiration setting. The channel also included moderator chatter, duplicate-message cleanup, and a joking scrape attempt.

#auth

Four participants discussed a possible CORS issue on the Auth login page, current API problems tracked on the status page, and the merits of keeping encrypted exports versus using automatic local backups.

#community-updates

A translation update announced that translations for Ente Photos, Auth, and Locker have been consolidated into one Ente Mobile project on Crowdin.

#space

A brief post celebrated securing an Ente Spaces handle.

#memes

One participant shared a video link.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 04, 2026 - 18 messages in 5 channels
item.description:

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 03, 2026 - 39 messages in 7 channels
item.description:
Ente Community saw moderate activity, led by discussion in #photos around album sharing, translations, and imports. #space and #ensu also had product questions and troubleshooting, while other channels were quieter.

#photos

With 15 messages from 9 participants, members discussed hiding Memories from the main feed, blank video thumbnails, and making shared album links more recognizable without compromising encryption. A Crowdin translation-count issue was clarified, with related work tracked in GitHub PR #11861; CLI imports for Photos were also queried.

#space

Nine messages from 4 participants covered claiming the Space role, keeping Space separate from Photos, and its encryption model; Anand confirmed Spaces use a separate key. A browser upload failure was traced to a company proxy, and the team noted that messaging and private replies already exist, with group-context comments under consideration.

#ensu

Seven messages from 2 participants focused on an iPhone/Safari web download error and differences between mobile and browser models. The app was suggested as a workaround, and the platform-specific model defaults were explained.

#off-topic

Four participants discussed passkey-only login, encryption constraints, and whether passkey PRF could help, including a link to an explanation of passkey PRF.

#introduce-yourself

Two newcomers briefly introduced themselves.

#clicks

One attachment was shared.

#memes

A reminder was posted to share appropriate memes.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 02, 2026 - 68 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw moderate activity, led by practical Ente Photos support discussions. Other conversations covered passkeys, Space profile aliases, account recovery, and a few casual greetings.

#photos

With 48 messages from 14 participants, the channel focused on update checks and troubleshooting, including Windows ARM compatibility, face and pet tagging, merging detected people, missing video thumbnails, and controlling Memories in the main feed. Members also shared troubleshooting guidance, including reporting issues with logs via support@ente.com, and linked a GIF.

#off-topic

Eight messages from five participants discussed passkeys and two-factor authentication, comparing implementations across Google, Microsoft, Ente, and different operating systems. The conversation also touched on services advertising themselves as ad-free while potentially introducing ads later.

#space

Six messages from two participants clarified that “login to existing account” refers to an Ente Photos account and explored using multiple aliases and profiles for family, friends, coworkers, and hobbies.

#auth

A reply addressed account recovery, explaining that the recovery key can bypass TOTP but not a forgotten password.

#introduce-yourself

Four participants exchanged greetings, including a new member welcoming Ente.

#memes

One participant shared a brief reaction to a meme.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 01, 2026 - 107 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
Ente Community saw its busiest activity in #photos and #space, with discussions spanning product questions, bug reports, browser compatibility, and feature feedback. Smaller channels covered account recovery, app architecture, product suggestions, and casual sharing.

#photos

With 55 messages from 20 participants, discussion covered the two open security advisories and pending CVEs, AppImage/Flatpak/Snap packaging, caching shared albums, and requests for improved photo-picker search and album access. Members also reported Linux Flatpak drag-and-drop upload failures, a GrapheneOS crash, and asked about encryption; the encryption architecture was shared, and the photo-picker request was added to the roadmap without an ETA.

#space

Thirty-five messages from 12 participants focused on Ente Space browser behavior, including Windows Brave/Chrome sharing issues and a Vanadium login spinner on GrapheneOS. A desktop browser fix to copy the link was reported as working, while several members shared enthusiasm about signing up and discussed account login and aliases.

#off-topic

Twelve messages covered Featurebase as a possible privacy-friendly feedback platform, including its Discord/GitHub integrations and AI help agent. The rest was casual discussion about social-network business models and an Ente plush, including a cat GIF.

#auth

A user raised a question about whether Ente Auth recovery could work with the recovery key alone after simulating the recovery process.

#ensu

Discussion asked why Ensu mobile apps use native frameworks rather than Flutter with Rust FFI.

#memes

One meme link was shared.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 31, 2026 - 13 messages in 4 channels
item.description:

#off-topic

#auth

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 30, 2026 - 27 messages in 5 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw light activity across five channels, with the most discussion focused on Ente Photos OCR and Auth installation options. Members also shared introductions, a video, and a few casual updates.

#photos

There were 10 messages from 6 participants. Discussion covered OCR issues with Polish and other non-English characters, setting Ente Photos as the default gallery app on NothingOS, and whether a liquid glass UI is planned. A member also reported progress on an immich-go adapter and asked about Ente’s exported JSON schema, while another praised the latest update’s smoothness.

#off-topic

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 27, 2026 - 23 messages in 4 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw light activity across four channels, with discussion focused mainly on border-device privacy, photo metadata/import behavior, and community contributions. Off-topic was the busiest channel, followed by photos.

#off-topic

Twelve messages from six participants discussed border searches, device resets, access requests, and related legal considerations in the US, Canada, and elsewhere. Members also discussed a recent rise in community pull requests, with one participant noting 43 PRs, and shared Kill the Cookie Banner.

#photos

Eight messages from four participants covered delays in new photos appearing in galleries, Immich’s importer behavior, sidecar files, EXIF date parsing, and compatibility with Google’s formats. The channel also briefly discussed iOS deletion permissions and the use of tags such as [mobile][photos] in pull requests.

#ensu

Two participants discussed improving model selection for systems with under or over 16 GB of RAM and troubleshooting a related setup. A follow-up offered to investigate after receiving more details.

#memes

One attachment was shared.
